score_rationale: The module is exceptionally well-structured for an AI, with high-quality acceptance criteria and a clear 'module-kind pin' that prevents common AI misinterpretations. However, it suffers from significant 'Dependency Closure' issues (D5) because it references many external scripts and folders that are not provided in the context, and the final file is truncated mid-sentence, losing critical workflow instructions.

issues.title: Missing External Dependencies
issues.why: The spec relies heavily on external linter scripts (e.g., check-tree-health.cjs, validate-guidelines.py) and source folders (e.g., spec/01-spec-authoring-guide/) that are not included in the provided context.
issues.fix: Include the source code or interface definitions for all referenced linter scripts and the content of the 'Source' folders in the prompt context.

issues.title: Content Truncation in Critical Workflow
issues.why: File 01-spec-authoring.md cuts off at the 'Mandatory Execution Order' section, leaving the AI without the final steps to maintain version parity and CI compliance.
issues.fix: Ensure the full content of 01-spec-authoring.md is provided, specifically the completion of the sync script execution sequence.

issues.title: Incomplete Example for Sync Scripts
issues.why: The 'Mandatory Execution Order' section starts a bash/node command list but terminates at 'python3 linter-scripts/c', preventing the AI from knowing the full command.
issues.fix: Provide the complete command string and a sample output for the synchronization workflow.
